description: Every Iconify icon from one Go binary, plus a local index that answers set-coverage, migration, and audit questions no icon tool answers today.

tools.name: icons_css
tools.description: Generate a CSS mask sprite for a list of icons from one set. Required: prefix, icons.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Icon set prefix, e.g. lucide

params.name: icons
params.description: Comma separated icon names

tools.name: icons_data
tools.description: Fetch many icons from one set as a single IconifyJSON payload. Required: prefix, icons.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Icon set prefix, e.g. lucide

params.name: icons
params.description: Comma separated icon names

tools.name: icons_get
tools.description: Fetch one icon as SVG, optionally recoloured and resized. Required: prefix, name. Optional: color, width, height (plus 3 more).

params.name: prefix
params.description: Icon set prefix, e.g. lucide

params.name: name
params.description: Icon name within the set, e.g. arrow-right

params.name: color
params.description: Replace currentColor with a fixed colour, e.g. '#404041'

params.name: width
params.description: Width. Setting only one dimension scales the other to match

params.name: height
params.description: Height. Setting only one dimension scales the other to match

params.name: flip
params.description: Flip the icon: horizontal, vertical, or both

params.name: rotate
params.description: Rotate by 90, 180, or 270 degrees

params.name: box
params.description: Add an empty rectangle matching the viewBox

tools.name: icons_search
tools.description: Search icons by keyword across every icon set. Required: query. Optional: limit (default: 64), start, prefix (plus 2 more).

params.name: query
params.description: Search text, case insensitive (e.g. 'arrow right')

params.name: limit
params.description: Result limit. The API clamps below 32 and above 999

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first result, for pagination

params.name: prefix
params.description: Restrict to one icon set, e.g. lucide

params.name: prefixes
params.description: Comma separated icon sets. Partial prefixes ending in '-' match a family, e.g. 'mdi-'

params.name: category
params.description: Restrict to icon sets in one category, e.g. 'General'

tools.name: keywords_list
tools.description: Suggest search keywords that start with or end with a fragment. Optional: prefix, keyword.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Return keywords starting with this fragment

params.name: keyword
params.description: Return keywords starting or ending with this fragment. Ignored when prefix is set

tools.name: meta_last-modified
tools.description: Get the last modification time per icon set, for cache invalidation and incremental sync. Optional: prefix, prefixes.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Restrict to one icon set

params.name: prefixes
params.description: Comma separated icon sets

tools.name: meta_version
tools.description: Report the Iconify API version and serving region.

tools.name: sets_get
tools.description: List every icon name in one set, with categories, aliases, and hidden icons. Required: prefix. Optional: info, chars.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Icon set prefix, e.g. lucide

params.name: info
params.description: Include the icon set's info block

params.name: chars
params.description: Include the character map, for sets imported from icon fonts

tools.name: sets_list
tools.description: List every icon set with its size, author, licence, and category. Optional: prefix, prefixes.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Restrict to one icon set

params.name: prefixes
params.description: Comma separated icon sets. Partial prefixes ending in '-' match a family

novel_features.name: Local corpus index
novel_features.description: Mirror icon sets and their icon names into local SQLite for offline search and analysis; --only scopes it to specific sets.

novel_features.name: Set coverage picker
novel_features.description: Given the icon concepts you need, rank icon sets by how many of them each set actually covers.

novel_features.name: shadcn.io registry bridge
novel_features.description: Turn Iconify icon names into shadcn.io registry slugs and optionally run the install.

novel_features.name: Manifest-driven icon kit
novel_features.description: Render a whole directory of recoloured, uniformly sized SVGs from a manifest of icon names.

novel_features.name: Repo icon audit
novel_features.description: Scan a codebase for Iconify references and report set spread, grid-height mismatches, palette mixing, and dead names.

novel_features.name: Set drift diff
novel_features.description: Show which icons an upstream set added, removed, or aliased since your last sync.

novel_features.name: Cross-set migration map
novel_features.description: Map a list of icons from one set to another, classifying each as covered, renamed, or missing.
